spans.s:
f. (-र्य्या)
A booth, a residence.

n. (-कं)
A multitude of the descendants of Upagu.
E.
औपगव the patronymic of उपगु, and वुन् aggregate aff.

m. (-कः)
An eclipse, or the sun or moon in eclipse.
E.
उपग्रस्त an eclipse, ठक् aff.

m. (-कः)
An eclipse, or the sun or moon in eclipse.
E.
उपग्रह an eclipse, ठञ् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Upon or near the knees.
E.
उपजानु, and ठक् aff.

n. (-यं)
The wheel of a carriage.
E.
उपधि, and ढञ् pleonasm.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Relating to the rite of investiture.
E.
उपनयन, and ठञ् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Relating to a deposit.
n. (-कं)
A deposit, the thing pledged or deposited.
E.
उपनिधि, and ठक् aff.

mfn. (-दः-दी-दं)
Scriptural, theological.
E.
उपनिषद, and अण् aff.

n. (-म्यं)
Resemblance, similitude.
E.
उपमा, and ष्यञ् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Right, fit, proper.
n. (-कं)
A means, an expedient.
E.
उपाय an expedient, ठक् aff.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टी-ष्टं)
Being or produced above.
E.
उपरिष्ट, and अण् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
1 Proceeding from or relating to kindness or favour.
2 Opposing, impeding, connected with or relating to a check or hindrance.
E.
उपरोध, and ठक् affix.
m. (-कः)
A staff of the wood of a particular tree, (the Pīlu.)
E.
उपरोध willingness to oblige, &c. ठक् aff.

mfn. (-लः-ली-लं)
Stony, of stone.
E.
उपल, and अण् aff.

n. (-स्तं)
Fasting, a fast.
E.
उपवस्त, and अण् aff.

mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं)
Drawn for pleasure, (a carriage.)
E.
उपवह a conveyance, यञ् aff.

Portentous.
2

Prepositive, connected with a preposition.
3 Relating to change, &c.
m. (-कः)
Irregular action of the humors of the body, producing cold sweats, &c.
E.
उपसर्ग a portent, ठक् aff.

n. (-स्थ्यं)
Cohabitation, sexual enjoyment.
E.
उपस्थ, and ष्यञ् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Preceptral, of or relating to a spiritual teacher.
E.
उपाध्याय, and वुञ् aff.

mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं)
To be tied or bound on (grass, leather, &c.)
E.
उपानह, and ञ्य aff.

mfn. (-नः-नी-नं)
Devotional, holy, connected with or belonging to worship or service.
E.
उपासना, and अण् aff.
